servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: The servers DBS connects to over SSH.

empty.title: No servers yet
empty.body: Add a server to check it and back it up.

check.title: Connection check
check.wait: A check can take up to a minute.
check.blocked: Every operation on this server is blocked until the host key is reviewed.

hostKey.title: Host key
hostKey.body: Every connection checks that the server presents this key.
hostKey.compare: Run this command on the server. It prints the fingerprint to compare.

review.title: Review host key
review.unchanged: The server presents the pinned key. There is nothing to change.
review.changed: The server presents a different key. Pin it only if the fingerprints match.
review.passwordHint: Pinning a new key needs your password.

passphrase.title: Backup passphrase
passphrase.body: It encrypts the django-dbs backups of this server. Keep a copy somewhere safe.
passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.copyUnavailable: Copying is not available here. Select the passphrase and copy it.

prompt.title: Show backup passphrase
prompt.body: Enter your password to show the backup passphrase.

delete.title: Delete server
delete.body: Removes this server from DBS. Backups stored on the server stay there.
delete.confirmBody: The server is removed from DBS. Backups stored on the server stay there.

name.label: Name
name.hint: A name to tell this server apart.

username.label: Username
username.hint: The account to sign in to over SSH.

privateKey.label: Private key
privateKey.hint: Paste the whole key, with its BEGIN and END lines.

keyPassphrase.label: Key passphrase
keyPassphrase.hint: Only if the key has one.

form.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
form.hostKeyIntro: Get the key the server presents, then compare its fingerprint on the server itself.
form.projectIntro: Fill these in to back up the Django project on this server. They can be added later.

pythonPath.label: Python command
pythonPath.hint: python3, or the Python of the project's virtual environment.

settingsModule.label: Settings module
settingsModule.hint: Leave empty to use the project's default.

remoteBackupDir.label: Remote backup folder
remoteBackupDir.hint: Where backups are written on the server.

fileRoots.label: Allowed folders
fileRoots.hint: Folders the Files tab can open. Press Enter after each one.

envPath.label: .env file
envPath.hint: Full path to the project's .env file, if it has one.

accountPassword.hint: Changing anything but the name needs your password.
